experiment: C8 exploratory cross-family depth-two hierarchy with attention-aware Canaria grammar

grammar.candidate: TinyAttnRes(d,w) = x + Wo(softmax(QK^T/sqrt(w))V), all projections bias-free

information_isolation.lower_pair_clusters: may use original pair-span targets during lower-IR construction
information_isolation.level1_pair_units: fit only from frozen lower-pair outputs
information_isolation.after_lower_ir_definition: original a4 forbidden as target for all hierarchical fits/adaptations; direct-original reference only

conditions.hierarchical_no_level2_adapt: fit final width64 only from independently recompiled C12+C34 outputs
conditions.hierarchical_level2_joint_adapt: jointly adapt C12+C34 to lower IR only, freeze, then fit final width64 only from adapted pair outputs
conditions.flat_lower_ir_single: fit final width64 directly to lower IR
conditions.direct_original_single: fit matched width64 directly to original a4 reference

final_single_fairness: identical initialization and minibatch RNG across final conditions within seed
endpoints: pre/post Level-2 pair NMSE vs lower IR and original
final NMSE vs immediate Canaria teacher and original
claim_boundary: Exploratory cross-family depth-two evidence only; no held-out test, no arbitrary-depth, no lossless, no large-model claim.
